nfr_classifications.requirement: Form generation latency < 5 minutes from transaction execution.
Real-time data streaming to legal/compliance delivered within 1 minute of form generation.
Dashboard reflects filing status changes within 1 minute.
Export (CSV/PDF) generated and delivered within 2 minutes of request.
All data transmissions use end-to-end encryption, TLS 1.2 or higher.
Role-based access control (RBAC) enforced for all actions; authentication aligns with existing corporate SSO.
nfr_classifications.citation: PRD §6 Security (role-based access controls); SSO alignment specifically from PRD §7 Constraints

nfr_classifications.requirement: Full audit logging of all actions, retained for 7 years.
nfr_classifications.citation: PRD §6 Security; retention period flagged for counsel confirmation of applicability to issuer (vs. broker-dealer) records
nfr_classifications.note: See vision.md Regulatory Posture — 7-year figure carried from PRD, applicability not independently verified against a specific SEC recordkeeping rule for this record type.

nfr_classifications.requirement: Support up to 10,000 concurrent users and 1,000 trades/minute without degradation.
99.9% uptime with automated failover and backup for all critical data.
Deadline-risk calculation must use the EDGAR 5:30pm ET same-day filing cutoff, not the raw 2-business-day calendar deadline.
nfr_classifications.citation: vision.md Regulatory Posture #2 (sourced: SEC EDGAR filing rules, sec.gov)
nfr_classifications.note: Direct pass-through of a Phase 0 regulatory finding — compliance NFRs cite the vision's Regulatory Posture section per the blueprint's stated pattern.

nfr_classifications.requirement: Form submission mechanism (direct EDGAR filer API vs. handoff to manual filing-agent process) must be confirmed before Design; system must not assume a mechanism.
Platform complies with WCAG 2.1 AA, including full keyboard navigation and screen-reader support.
Review interface for legal/compliance users loads in under 2 seconds and supports concurrent edits.
